title: Dynamo v1.6.0-minimax-m3-dev.1
text:
Release Notes
Dynamo v1.6.0-minimax-m3-dev.1 is an experimental snapshot build with early MiniMax M3 support on the Dynamo vLLM backend. It is not recommended for production and is not a QA-gated release. APIs, behavior, and defaults may change before stable support. Use it for evaluation, testing, and early feedback only.
Summary
Dynamo v1.6.0-minimax-m3-dev.1 serves nvidia/MiniMax-M3-NVFP4 on Dynamo vLLM. The published container is built from pinned vLLM nightly 8a728663c1c3 (CUDA 13) and includes the MiniMax M3 reasoning and structured-output parser, a GB200-safe vision patch embedding, and KV-offload fixes for EAGLE/MTP. vLLM-Omni is excluded from this image. Prefill load accounting charges only GPU compute, and finalized VP9/WebM inputs can be decoded when duration is stored on the container rather than the stream (#14856).
Kubernetes recipes serve the same checkpoint on GB200 with tensor parallelism 4, FP8 KV cache, real EAGLE3 verification, KV-aware routing, and a one-million-token context. The aggregated profile uses 12 GPUs and 400 GB of CPU KV offload per replica. The disaggregated profile uses 24 GPUs and transfers KV from prefill to decode with NIXL. Both profiles share a model-cache download for the target and Inferact/MiniMax-M3-EAGLE3-GQA draft, and a perf/trace reference ships with the recipes (#15096, #16043).

About MiniMax M3
MiniMax M3 is served in this preview as nvidia/MiniMax-M3-NVFP4 (NVFP4) through Dynamo's vLLM backend on GB200, with aggregated or prefill/decode disaggregated workers, EAGLE3 speculative decoding, and KV-aware routing.
Full Changelog
vLLM Backend
MiniMax M3 runtime: Pins the CUDA 13 vLLM runtime to nightly 8a728663c1c3 and applies the MiniMax M3 reasoning/structured-output parser, the vision-tower patch embedding used on GB200, and KV-offload fixes that keep the final sampled token out of the prefix cache and preserve EAGLE/MTP offload hits. vLLM-Omni is not installed (#14856).
Routing and media decode: Prefill load accounting counts only tokens that still need GPU compute, including when KV is already resident on host or disk. Finalized VP9/WebM inputs decode when duration is present on the container and missing from the video stream (#14856).
Recipes
MiniMax M3 recipes: Added recipes/minimax-m3 — shared model-cache PVC and pinned Hugging Face download, vLLM aggregated (agg-gb200-agentic, 3x TP4, 400 GB CPU KV offload per replica) and disaggregated (disagg-gb200-agentic, 3 prefill + 3 decode TP4, NIXL transfer) GB200 profiles, real EAGLE3 verification by default, and a perf/trace reference (recipe folder, README, #15096, #16043).
Getting Started
Deployment is Kubernetes-based (Dynamo Platform, ComputeDomain, the NVIDIA DRA driver, and DynamoGraphDeployment). Full steps — namespace, hf-token-secret, model-cache PVC, Hugging Face download of the target and EAGLE3 draft, cluster Kustomize render, DGD apply, and a /v1/chat/completions smoke test — are in the recipe README. The token needs access to nvidia/MiniMax-M3-NVFP4 and Inferact/MiniMax-M3-EAGLE3-GQA. Recipes expect registry credentials for nvcr.io and a Hugging Face token secret named hf-token-secret.
Known Issues / Limitations
Experimental snapshot build — not QA-gated; not for production.
This image does not include vLLM-Omni.
Recipes in this build are vLLM on GB200 only.
Disaggregated workers must share a compatible NVLink domain.
The synthetic-acceptance benchmark option bypasses real EAGLE3 verification. Use it only for controlled performance experiments.
